clue.text: Anything in study can be understood

indicators.note: in says one piece sits inside the other here

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
aught is an archaic word for anything

explanation.surface: Whatever you study can be grasped with effort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be' is a link; the past participle definition matches the phrasal verb's past form.
explanation.definitionFit: To have caught on is to have grasped or understood an idea.

clue.text: When essential, provide a source of water on small island

parts.note: a tap supplies water
inch is a Scottish word for a small island

explanation.surface: In an emergency, install a water tap on a little island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'provide' and 'on' are links; INCH for an islet is common in Scottish place names (Inchcolm).
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something at a pinch means doing it if necessary, in an emergency.

clue.text: Act immoderatey when told to leave the trenches

definitions.meaning: the World War I order to climb out of the trench and attack

explanation.surface: A soldier goes wild on being ordered out of the trenches.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase meant charging out over the parapet in war, and figuratively now means overdoing things.

clue.text: Nectar produced a state of hypnosis

indicators.note: produced suggests the letters have been worked into something new

explanation.surface: A drink of nectar sent someone into a hypnotic state.
explanation.definitionFit: A trance is a dazed, hypnotic condition of suspended consciousness.

clue.text: Refusal by Virginia to become a star

parts.note: no is a refusal
VA is the US postal abbreviation for Virginia

explanation.surface: Virginia says no to being made a celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: A nova is a star that suddenly flares in brightness.

clue.text: Pennant flown by ship circling river

indicators.note: circling says the vessel surrounds the other piece

parts.note: a steamer is a steamship

explanation.surface: A flag flies from a vessel going round a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circling' puts R inside STEAMER after the T.
explanation.definitionFit: A streamer is a long narrow flag or ribbon, like a pennant.

clue.text: Supposing that America upsets a Muslim

indicators.note: in a down clue upsets means the pieces are turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: if means supposing that

explanation.surface: A hypothetical about America offending a Muslim.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upsets' flips the whole two-word phrase upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: A Sufi is a Muslim mystic.

clue.text: Didn't give up one's pet bird, apparently

definitions.meaning: read whimsically as ..., owned a small bird as a pet

explanation.surface: Someone stuck with keeping a pet bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Persevering with a task is described as having kept going or persisted with it.

clue.text: York's current consumption of bean curd has been abandoned

indicators.note: consumption of has the river swallowing the other piece

parts.note: the Ouse is the river flowing through York
tofu is bean curd

explanation.surface: York's appetite for tofu has dwindled to nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ouse is the river through the English city of York; 'has been' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something no longer used has been discarded or given up.

clue.text: To a great extent love is a chancy game

parts.note: far means by a great deal
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Much of love is a gamble.
explanation.definitionFit: Faro is a gambling card game once popular in America.

clue.text: Good spot to view exciting juncture in tennis game

definitions.meaning: a position that gives a fine view
a tense moment when one player has advantage and the next rally is decisive

explanation.surface: A fan finds the best seat for a thrilling moment at Wimbledon.
explanation.walkthrough: Vantage is an old word for advantage in tennis scoring, so the point played from it is a crucial one.
explanation.definitionFit: A vantage point is a position offering a commanding outlook, and in tennis a point at advantage.

clue.text: How he let lies be spread to make things run smoothly

indicators.note: spread out means the letters are scattered and laid out again

explanation.surface: A cynic explains how he allowed falsehoods to circulate so business would go smoothly.
explanation.definitionFit: To oil the wheels is an idiom for easing a process, like lubricating machinery.

clue.text: Most ill-disposed to find a resting-place

indicators.note: place here is read as an instruction to put the letters in a new order

explanation.surface: Seeking somewhere to rest while in the worst of tempers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'place' rearranges ARESTING; 'to find' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill-disposed means hostile or cross, so the most ill-disposed is the crossest.

clue.text: Vagrant parking behind a passenger vehicle

indicators.note: behind places one piece after the other in a down clue

parts.note: a tram carries passengers
P is the standard sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A tramp parks behind a bus.
explanation.definitionFit: A tramp is a homeless wanderer, a vagabond.

clue.text: Harry is a spy, by the way

parts.note: a mole is a spy planted inside an organisation
ST is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: A man called Harry turns out to be a spy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Harry' is a verb meaning harass, not a name.
explanation.definitionFit: To harry is to pester or harass someone.

clue.text: A ruler coming from the pasha hierarchy

indicators.note: coming from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A monarch emerging from the Ottoman ranks.
explanation.definitionFit: A shah was the title of the monarch of Iran.

clue.text: Bob finds a quicker way

definitions.meaning: a bob is a hairstyle cut short

explanation.surface: Bob discovers a faster route.
explanation.definitionFit: A bob is a short haircut, and a quicker route is a short cut.

clue.text: A step-up for one accommodated by top actor

indicators.note: accommodated by means housed within the other piece

parts.note: a star is a leading actor
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A star actor puts someone up as a step forward in their career.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accommodated by' puts I inside STAR; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A stair is a single step in a flight, each one leading upward.

clue.text: Airmen in a painful attack — on the enemy?

definitions.text: Airmen in a painful attack — on the enemy?

indicators.note: in places the airmen within the attack

parts.note: a sting is a sharp painful wound
the RAF is Britain's Royal Air Force

explanation.surface: Pilots carry out a painful assault on enemy lines.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: low-flying pilots shooting at enemy ground troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Strafing is attacking ground targets with gunfire from low-flying aircraft.

clue.text: Crippled, so has to stop

explanation.surface: Injured, so they have to stop.
explanation.definitionFit: Halt is an archaic adjective for lame, and also a word for coming to a stop.

clue.text: Big trap for the aspiring teetotaller

definitions.text: Big trap for the aspiring teetotaller

parts.note: large means big
a gin is a snare or trap

explanation.surface: A double measure is a pitfall for someone trying to go dry.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a generous spirit is a temptation for someone trying to give up drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A double serving of spirit is exactly what tempts someone trying to stop drinking.

clue.text: Alternatively return list to one who gives address

parts.note: or introduces an alternative

indicators.note: return means the duty list comes back the other way

parts.note: a rota is a list of duties

explanation.surface: Alternatively, send the list back to the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' reverses ROTA to ATOR; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An address is a formal speech, so an orator is a public speaker.

clue.text: Convey information which gives one entry

parts.note: to pass on is to convey
word means news or information

explanation.surface: Passing on news that lets someone in.
explanation.definitionFit: A password is a secret code that grants admission.

clue.text: Old-fashioned town centre, perhaps

definitions.meaning: an open plaza often at the heart of a town

explanation.surface: An outdated town centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A square is a fogey, and also an open public space in a town.

clue.text: Try to bribe pianist to play, but risk retribution

definitions.text: Try to bribe pianist to play
definitions.meaning: read whimsically as ..., lure a musician into performing
take a chance that could bring bad luck

explanation.surface: Offering a pianist money to perform could backfire.
explanation.walkthrough: The first half splits the phrase as TEMPT FOR TUNE: entice a pianist for a tune.
explanation.definitionFit: To tempt fate is to take a needless risk that invites misfortune.

clue.text: Where the host is elevated before a host of people

definitions.meaning: in the Catholic service the consecrated bread is raised up

explanation.surface: A ceremony before a large crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'host' is first the eucharistic wafer, then a multitude.
explanation.definitionFit: Mass is the eucharistic service, and a mass is also a big crowd.

clue.text: Said to have gone by boat — but as a passenger

indicators.note: said signals a word that sounds alike when spoken

parts.note: rowed means went by boat under oar power

explanation.surface: Claiming to have sailed, though only as a passenger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Said' signals the sound-alike; 'but' contrasts rowing with merely riding as a passenger.
explanation.definitionFit: To ride is to travel carried by a vehicle or animal rather than propelling it oneself.

clue.text: So Her Majesty has to leave

parts.note: ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen
go means leave

explanation.surface: So the Queen must depart.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergo is Latin for therefore.

clue.text: Ending US resolution not yet ratified

indicators.note: resolution, as in resolving into parts, lets the letters be broken up and reset

explanation.surface: A United Nations resolution to end matters with the US remains unapproved.
explanation.definitionFit: A treaty not yet ratified lacks its formal signature.

clue.text: Service is nevertheless no good

parts.note: even so means nevertheless

explanation.surface: The church service is useless all the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is the Anglican evening prayer service.
